title: Hello World: Welcome to My Blog
excerpt: An introduction to my new blog where I'll share thoughts on software development, design, and technology.
content:
Welcome to my blog! This is where I'll be sharing insights, tips, and stories about software development, design, and the technology landscape.

Whether you're a developer, designer, or just curious about tech, I hope you'll find something interesting here. Expect posts covering:

  • Web development best practices
  • Design principles and UX insights
  • Tools and technologies I'm exploring
  • Reflections on the tech industry

Thanks for stopping by, and feel free to reach out if you have any thoughts or questions!

title: Building a Modern Portfolio with Blazor
excerpt: A deep dive into creating an interactive portfolio using Blazor WebAssembly, CSS3, and modern web standards.
content:
Creating a portfolio is more than just showcasing your work—it's an opportunity to demonstrate your skills and approach to development.

I decided to build mine using Blazor WebAssembly for several reasons:

  • C# everywhere: Write frontend logic in a language I'm comfortable with
  • Component-based: Reusable, maintainable components
  • Performance: Fast, interactive experiences without heavy frameworks
  • Static hosting: Deploy anywhere, even to basic static hosts

The result is a responsive, fast-loading portfolio that showcases both my work and my technical choices. If you're considering Blazor for your next project, I'd recommend it!
